entries.proposition: SYSTEM: one patient-derived iPSC line (Coriell GM27896, SLC2A1 P485L), undifferentiated, cultured in 13.5 mM glucose; treatments decanoic acid, octanoic acid or an 80:20 blend at 150 uM for 4 days; RNA-seq of triplicates.
Sample size was justified by an earlier study, not by a power calculation for this experiment.
entries.snippet: Sample size requirements were defined from an earlier study.

entries.proposition: MAGNITUDE: 11,271 genes change significantly (about half of the expressed transcriptome), 84 percent by the decanoic-containing treatments; a change of that breadth is a global cell-state effect rather than a pathway-specific one.
